Spin Pair.name: Spin Pair
Spin Pair.summary: A falling blocks puzzle game for the PC Engine. By matching pairs of symbols with opposing designs, they will cancel each other out and remove similar symbols from the grid.

Super Metal Crusher.name: Super Metal Crusher
Super Metal Crusher.summary:
Strategy game where you design a robot by allocating points to various stats, then let it scrap it out with an opponent while you watch.

(From The PC Engine Software Bible)
